recommendations.text: Non-invasive HTM may be considered for patients with HF in order to reduce the risk of recurrent CV and HF hospitalizations and CV death.
Monitoring of pulmonary artery pressure using a wireless haemodynamic monitoring system may be considered in symptomatic patients with HFrEF (LVEF ≤35%) in order to improve clinical outcomes.

abbreviations.HFrEF: heart failure with reduced ejection fraction

section_10.title: Advanced heart failure
key_points: Many patients with HF progress into a phase of advanced HF characterized by persistent symptoms despite maximal therapy.
The prevalence of advanced HF is increasing due to the growing number of patients with HF, ageing of the population, and better treatment and survival of HF.
Prognosis remains poor, with a 1-year mortality ranging from 25% to 75%.

Updated HFA-ESC 2018 criteria for the definition of advanced HF are reported in Table 13; severely reduced LVEF is common but not required for diagnosis and advanced HF may develop in patients with HFpEF as well. Extra-cardiac organ dysfunction due to HF may be present.
